provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^159 - 1 with a(x) = x^2 + x^17 + x^20 + x^35 + x^77 + x^86 + x^89 + x^99 + x^132 + x^140 + x^143 + x^149 + x^152 + x^158, b(x) = x^37 + x^38 + x^50 + x^86 + x^101 + x^122 + x^125 + x^154; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed.
